title: Apache Ranger：標籤分類、資源匹配與例外審查
titleEn: Apache Ranger: tag classification, resource matching and exception review
subcategoryTitle: 授權語意、相依與一致性
summary: 建立十個資料資源，列路徑、PII標籤、讀取角色及核准例外；先定義本課只允許合規角色讀取PII，其他標籤不受這條規則影響。
summaryEn: Build ten resources with paths, PII tags, reader roles and approved exceptions. Define the local rule before testing: only the selected compliant role may read PII; resources without that tag remain subject to other policies rather than this one rule.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「Apache Ranger · 信任契約與反例資料」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Apache Ranger · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 資源未受限制可能是標籤同步未到，或資源路徑規則匹配錯誤；單看政策已發布無法確認分類已送達插件。
將分類真值表、標籤同步版本及資源政策共同審查；例外採最小範圍並回歸期限負例，禁止為提升覆蓋數字而亂貼敏感標籤。
Ranger支援資源與標籤政策及允許/拒絕例外；本課以明訂的本地敏感資料規則分析分類覆蓋，避免假設所有服務插件的例外語意完全相同。
optionsEn: An unprotected resource may reflect delayed tag synchronization or an incorrect resource-path match. Published policy status alone does not establish that classification reached the enforcing plugin.

Review ground truth, tag-sync revision and resource policy together. Keep exceptions narrowly scoped and test expiration; do not attach arbitrary sensitive labels merely to improve a coverage statistic without validating classification accuracy.

Ranger supports resource and tag policies with allow/deny exceptions. Analyze classification coverage under an explicit local sensitive-data rule, without assuming identical exception behavior or feature support across every service plugin and deployed version.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。Ranger支援資源與標籤政策及允許/拒絕例外；本課以明訂的本地敏感資料規則分析分類覆蓋，避免假設所有服務插件的例外語意完全相同。 與本階段判準一起判讀：為本課建立 fixture.csv：每列記錄識別碼、完整輸入、信任來源、預期判定及理由；正常與異常資料都保留。未提供的屬性保持缺值，不可悄悄補成允許值。先寫預期結果，再進行測試，並區分協定要求與自行選定的教學門檻。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Ranger supports resource and tag policies with allow/deny exceptions. Analyze classification coverage under an explicit local sensitive-data rule, without assuming identical exception behavior or feature support across every service plugin and deployed version. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Create fixture.csv for this case with row ID, complete inputs, trust source, expected decision and reason. Retain valid and invalid rows. Keep absent attributes absent instead of silently replacing them with permissive values. Write expected outcomes before evaluating the fixtures, and distinguish protocol requirements from thresholds selected only for this exercise.

對照「Apache Ranger · 信任契約與反例資料」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。將分類真值表、標籤同步版本及資源政策共同審查；例外採最小範圍並回歸期限負例，禁止為提升覆蓋數字而亂貼敏感標籤。

steps.instructionEn:
An unprotected resource may reflect delayed tag synchronization or an incorrect resource-path match. Published policy status alone does not establish that classification reached the enforcing plugin.
Against the nominal Apache Ranger · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Review ground truth, tag-sync revision and resource policy together. Keep exceptions narrowly scoped and test expiration; do not attach arbitrary sensitive labels merely to improve a coverage statistic without validating classification accuracy.
Reverify this criterion: Create fixture.csv for this case with row ID, complete inputs, trust source, expected decision and reason. Retain valid and invalid rows. Keep absent attributes absent instead of silently replacing them with permissive values. Write expected outcomes before evaluating the fixtures, and distinguish protocol requirements from thresholds selected only for this exercise.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Ranger支援資源與標籤政策及允許/拒絕例外；本課以明訂的本地敏感資料規則分析分類覆蓋，避免假設所有服務插件的例外語意完全相同。
knowledge.textEn: Ranger supports resource and tag policies with allow/deny exceptions. Analyze classification coverage under an explicit local sensitive-data rule, without assuming identical exception behavior or feature support across every service plugin and deployed version.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立十個資料資源，列路徑、PII標籤、讀取角色及核准例外；先定義本課只允許合規角色讀取PII，其他標籤不受這條規則影響。
knowledge.textEn: Build ten resources with paths, PII tags, reader roles and approved exceptions. Define the local rule before testing: only the selected compliant role may read PII; resources without that tag remain subject to other policies rather than this one rule.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 本課計算應標PII且已正確標記的覆蓋率；缺標是分類缺口，不代表資源本來不敏感。所有例外需獨立理由及到期，不能由通過率倒推核准。
knowledge.textEn: Measure correctly tagged resources among those that should be classified PII. Missing tags are classification gaps, not proof of nonsensitivity. Exceptions require separate justification and expiry and cannot be authorized by a favorable aggregate pass rate.

steps.objective: 完成「Apache Ranger · 信任契約與反例資料」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Apache Ranger · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付ranger-tag-coverage.csv、例外期限表及同步/匹配診斷；資料資源均為虛構名稱，不含任何PII內容。
在交接件中加入「Apache Ranger · 信任契約與反例資料」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：為本課建立 fixture.csv：每列記錄識別碼、完整輸入、信任來源、預期判定及理由；正常與異常資料都保留。未提供的屬性保持缺值，不可悄悄補成允許值。先寫預期結果，再進行測試，並區分協定要求與自行選定的教學門檻。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立十個資料資源，列路徑、PII標籤、讀取角色及核准例外；先定義本課只允許合規角色讀取PII，其他標籤不受這條規則影響。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。

Deliver ranger-tag-coverage.csv, the exception-expiry table and sync/matching diagnoses. Resource names are fictional and contain no personal information or real data samples.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Apache Ranger · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures: Create fixture.csv for this case with row ID, complete inputs, trust source, expected decision and reason. Retain valid and invalid rows. Keep absent attributes absent instead of silently replacing them with permissive values. Write expected outcomes before evaluating the fixtures, and distinguish protocol requirements from thresholds selected only for this exercise.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build ten resources with paths, PII tags, reader roles and approved exceptions. Define the local rule before testing: only the selected compliant role may read PII; resources without that tag remain subject to other policies rather than this one rule. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。為本課建立 fixture.csv：每列記錄識別碼、完整輸入、信任來源、預期判定及理由；正常與異常資料都保留。未提供的屬性保持缺值，不可悄悄補成允許值。先寫預期結果，再進行測試，並區分協定要求與自行選定的教學門檻。
